description: Randomly spaced impulses with random amplitudes, ported from the SuperCollider Dust generator; slow settings give random triggers, fast settings give white noise

params.text: Sets how often an impulse appears, from silence at the bottom of its 0 to 4 range to one impulse every sample at the top; the response is cubic, so most of the motion is near the top
The + setting gives positive impulses over 0-10V; the + / - setting gives impulses of either sign between -5V and 5V

inputs.text: Added straight to the Density knob, whose range is 0 to 4, so one volt covers a quarter of it

outputs.text: The impulses; between them the output rests at 0V
